incidents-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected on inference gateway for multiple routes. 5xx spike starting 2024-05-07T02:10Z. Affected: /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat/completions, rerank. Alert: 3.2x baseline error rate, increased latency.

Sanjay R: I'm on pager. pulling runbook now — linking playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

Kate M: Observing large traffic from a single API key hitting embeddings. Likely a runaway job. Top offending key: api-3x9... (truncated)

Maria L: Can we do per-endpoint throttles quickly? Prefer to avoid global quota as that hurts low-volume customers.

Sanjay R: Agreed. I'm going to apply route-specific rate limit to embeddings first. Will add a soft 100 qps cap for that key and 500 qps global for embeddings while we triage.

Carla P: Also seeing rerank latency up to 12s on p99. Suggest disabling rerank for hosted tier temporarily, route: /v1/rerank.

Ezra: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Per-key throttle on offending key 2) Per-route soft limits: embeddings=500 qps, chat=1200 qps, rerank=0 (disabled) 3) Notify affected customers. OK with that?

Kate M: +1. How do we apply? Is there a command? ops-bot can change quotas via infra API.

Sanjay R: Using infra-admin. Command:
```
POST /admin/configuration/quotas
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "qps": 500,
  "scope": "route"
}
```
Applying now for embeddings.

ops-bot: quota update accepted for /v1/embeddings -> 500 qps (actor: Sanjay R)

Sanjay R: Throttled offending API key to 100 qps via key-management

ops-bot: API key policy applied: api-3x9... -> 100 qps (actor: Sanjay R)

Maria L: Applying chat limit to 1200 qps now.

ops-bot: quota update accepted for /v1/chat/completions -> 1200 qps (actor: Maria L)

Carla P: Disabling rerank route for hosted customers. Pushing feature-flag off: `feature.rerank.hosted = false`

ops-bot: feature flag updated: feature.rerank.hosted=false (actor: Carla P)

Kate M: Monitoring dashboards — error rate for embeddings dropped by ~60% within 3 minutes. Latency p95 improved from 2.8s -> 1.1s.

Sanjay R: Good. Now need to assess customer impact. Which customers hit errors after throttles? Kate, can you pull the API key audit and list top 10 affected tenants?

Kate M: Pulling. Top affected tenants: acme-inc (high), dev-tools-svc (medium), sandbox-user-23 (low). Sending DM with specifics to SEs.

Maria L: I'll draft a customer message template: short description, what we changed, ETA for rollback, and contact info.

Sanjay R: Handoff to night oncall in 35m. @Ezra you'll be secondary monitoring for next 2 hrs. I'll remain available for escalation.

Ezra: Ack. I'll keep an eye on SLO dashboards and alerts. If errors creep back above 1.5x baseline, I'll escalate to execs.

Carla P: Post-mortem note: we need automated per-key runaway detection to auto-throttle before it impacts routing. Opening a ticket: ENG-1198.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-1457 (owner: Sanjay R)

Sanjay R: Status update to statuspage: We reduced load via route-specific throttles; no data loss; some customers may see 429s for embeddings and rerank disabled for hosted tier. Working on sustainable fix.

incidents-bot: incident status updated -> mitigation_in_place (actor: Sanjay R)

Ezra: P99 latency for rerank is down to baseline since disabled. Embeddings now stable. We'll keep these temporary quotas in place until tomorrow morning or until a fix is deployed.

Kate M: Logging handoff: Sanjay -> Ezra at 2024-05-07T03:45Z. Notes: quotas applied, rerank disabled, key throttled, customers notified.

Sanjay R: Closing initial triage. Action items: 1) Rate-limit automation (ENG-1198) 2) Improve per-route analytics for quicker detection (ENG-1201) 3) Follow up with top-3 affected customers (SEs). I'll own the incident write-up.

Maria L: Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: incident INC-2024-1457 moved to monitoring. Last update: 2024-05-07T04:05Z
